record.paper_title: Open Problems on Ultrafilters and Some Connections to the Continuum
record.original_question: For regular ultrafilters D and D', does equality of cut spectra C(D) = C(D') imply that D and D' saturate the same complete countable theories? Equivalently, does each equivalence class in Keisler's order correspond to a set of cuts?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\lambda$ be an infinite cardinal and let $D$ be an ultrafilter on $\lambda$. Recall that $D$ is regular if there exists a family $\{X_\alpha : \alpha < \lambda\} \subseteq D$ such that every infinite subfamily has empty intersection. For a complete countable first-order theory $T$, say that $D$ saturates $T$ if for every model $M \models T$, the ultrapower $M^\lambda/D$ is $\lambda^+$-saturated; this property depends only on $T$, not on the choice of $M$. Keisler's order $\trianglelefteq$ on complete countable theories is defined by $T_1 \trianglelefteq T_2$ iff for every infinite $\lambda$ and every regular ultrafilter $D$ on $\lambda$, if $D$ saturates $T_2$ then $D$ saturates $T_1$. Two regular ultrafilters $D, D'$ are Keisler-equivalent if they saturate exactly the same complete countable theories.

For a regular ultrafilter $D$ on $\lambda$, define the cut spectrum $C(D)$ to be the set of pairs $(\kappa_1, \kappa_2)$ of regular cardinals with $\kappa_1 + \kappa_2 \le \lambda$ such that there exist sequences $(a_\alpha)_{\alpha < \kappa_1}$ and $(b_\beta)_{\beta < \kappa_2}$ in some ultrapower $(\mathbb{N}, <)^\lambda/D$ satisfying $a_\alpha < a_{\alpha'} < b_{\beta'} < b_\beta$ for $\alpha < \alpha' < \kappa_1$, $\beta < \beta' < \kappa_2$, with no element of the ultrapower lying between all the $a_\alpha$ and all the $b_\beta$ (i.e., the pair realizes a $(\kappa_1,\kappa_2)$-pre-cut that is unfilled).

Question: Do regular ultrafilters $D, D'$ with $C(D) = C(D')$ necessarily saturate the same complete countable theories? Equivalently, does every equivalence class of Keisler's order on regular ultrafilters correspond to (i.e., is determined by) a set of cuts in the cut spectrum?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the cut spectrum $C(D)$ determines the Keisler class of a regular ultrafilter $D$ is part of an active line of research initiated by Malliaris and Shelah on the interaction between cut spectra and Keisler's order. Recent literature (including work on cofinality spectrum theorems and constructing regular ultrafilters from a model-theoretic point of view) continues to investigate which cuts correspond to which theories, but no general result establishing that $C(D) = C(D')$ implies Keisler equivalence appears in the literature, and the problem is presented as open.

status_evidence.title: Cofinality spectrum theorems in model theory, set theory and general topology
status_evidence.snippet: Cut spectra are studied as invariants of regular ultrafilters connected to saturation of theories in Keisler's order.
status_evidence.claim: Cut spectra and Keisler-order saturation are an active topic with no full correspondence theorem established.

status_evidence.title: Constructing regular ultrafilters from a model-theoretic point of view
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs regular ultrafilters separating theories in Keisler's order via control of cuts.
status_evidence.claim: Cuts are used to distinguish Keisler classes but a full equivalence with $C(D)$ is not established.
